package game

import (
	player "MMO_MODULE/game/entities/player"
	sceneentity "MMO_MODULE/game/entities/scene"
	"MMO_MODULE/game/handler"
	syncsender "MMO_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	"MMO_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/entitysync"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/frame"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/spatial"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/bson"
	"net"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// 真 TCP 客户端使用正式 Receiver 检查基线，并按 ObjectRef 应用 create/update/remove。
// 不能仅统计有几包：旧地图对象必须消失，新地图对象必须出现。
type mmoWireClient struct {
	mu         sync.Mutex
	connection net.Conn
	receiver   *frame.Receiver
	objects    map[frame.ObjectRef]int64
	documents  map[int64]bson.M
	lastRaw    []byte
	epoch      uint32
	err        error
}

func dialMMOWireClient(t *testing.T, addr string, id int64) *mmoWireClient {
	t.Helper()
	connection, err := net.Dial("tcp", addr)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = connection.Close() })
	_ = connection.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second))
	if err := writeSceneFrame(connection, 0, 1, []byte(fmt.Sprintf("session:%d:ticket", id))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, _, err := readSceneFrame(connection); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = connection.SetDeadline(time.Time{})
	client := &mmoWireClient{connection: connection, receiver: frame.NewReceiver(frame.DefaultLimits()), objects: map[frame.ObjectRef]int64{}, documents: map[int64]bson.M{}}
	go func() {
		for {
			msg, raw, err := readSceneFrame(connection)
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			if msg != msgid.MsgEntitySync {
				continue
			}
			client.mu.Lock()
			_, err = client.receiver.Receive(raw, func(f frame.Frame) error {
				if f.Kind == frame.Full {
					clear(client.objects)
					clear(client.documents)
				}
				for _, object := range f.Objects {
					if object.Operation == frame.ObjectRemove {
						delete(client.documents, client.objects[object.Ref])
						delete(client.objects, object.Ref)
						continue
					}
					for _, component := range object.Components {
						update, decodeErr := entitysync.DecodeSubjectUpdate(component.Data, 0)
						if decodeErr != nil {
							return decodeErr
						}
						client.objects[object.Ref] = update.SubjectID
						var document bson.M
						if err := bson.Unmarshal(update.Payload.BytesCopy(), &document); err != nil {
							return err
						}
						client.documents[update.SubjectID] = document
					}
				}
				client.epoch = f.Epoch
				return nil
			})
			if err != nil {
				client.err = err
			}
			client.lastRaw = append([]byte(nil), raw...)
			client.mu.Unlock()
		}
	}()
	return client
}
func (client *mmoWireClient) expect(t *testing.T, ids ...int64) {
	t.Helper()
	sort.Slice(ids, func(i, j int) bool { return ids[i] < ids[j] })
	deadline := time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)
	for {
		client.mu.Lock()
		got := []int64{}
		for _, id := range client.objects {
			got = append(got, id)
		}
		err := client.err
		client.mu.Unlock()
		sort.Slice(got, func(i, j int) bool { return got[i] < got[j] })
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if fmt.Sprint(got) == fmt.Sprint(ids) {
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("client objects %v, want %v", got, ids)
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}
func TestMMORPGTwoScenesTCPTransferRetryAndReconnect(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	transport, addr := startScenePlayerTransport(t)
	players := []*player.Player{newScenePlayer(t, 9701), newScenePlayer(t, 9702), newScenePlayer(t, 9703)}
	scenes := make([]*sceneentity.Scene, 2)
	entities := map[int64]entity.IThreadSafeEntity{}
	sceneentity.RegisterEntity()
	for i := range scenes {
		id, _ := entity.BuildEntityID(int64(701+i), sceneentity.EntityKindScene)
		built, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: id, Kind: sceneentity.EntityKindScene})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		scenes[i] = built.(*sceneentity.Scene)
		entities[id] = built
		t.Cleanup(func() { scenes[i].OnDestroy(entity.DestroyReasonMemoryUnload) })
	}
	for _, p := range players {
		entities[p.ID()] = p
	}
	handler.RegisterEnterSceneNestHandlers()
	engine := newSceneNest(t, entities)
	read := nest.NewHandlerName("mmo_scene_location")
	type location struct {
		id int64
		at spatial.Point
	}
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(read, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		p := es[0].(*player.Player)
		return location{p.MapComp().SceneID(), p.MapComp().Pos()}, nil
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{})
	seed := nest.NewHandlerName("mmo_private_fields")
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(seed, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		p := es[0].(*player.Player)
		p.Dao().SetGold(123)
		p.Dao().SetExp(987)
		p.PublishSyncDirty()
		return nil, nil
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityStrict})
	for _, p := range players {
		if _, err := engine.Request(ctx, seed, p.ID(), nil); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	world, err := newMMOScenes(transport, func(ctx context.Context, id int64) (int64, spatial.Point, error) {
		v, err := engine.Request(ctx, read, id, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, spatial.Point{}, err
		}
		p := v.(location)
		return p.id, p.at, nil
	}, scenes[0].ID(), scenes[1].ID())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = world.manager.Close(ctx) })
	clients := make([]*mmoWireClient, 3)
	for i, p := range players {
		clients[i] = dialMMOWireClient(t, addr, entity.GetUniqueIDFromEntityID(p.ID()))
		waitActiveSessions(t, transport, entity.GetUniqueIDFromEntityID(p.ID()), 1)
		if err := world.Register(p); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		scene := scenes[0]
		if i == 2 {
			scene = scenes[1]
		}
		if _, err := syncsender.NewEnterSceneSender(engine).MultiSync_EnterScene(ctx, p.ID(), scene.ID(), 500, 500); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := world.Reconcile(ctx, p.ID(), nil); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	flush := func() {
		t.Helper()
		if err := world.manager.Flush(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	flush()
	clients[0].expect(t, players[0].ID(), players[1].ID())
	clients[2].expect(t, players[2].ID())
	clients[0].mu.Lock()
	own, other := clients[0].documents[players[0].ID()], clients[0].documents[players[1].ID()]
	clients[0].mu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := own["gold"]; !ok {
		t.Fatal("owner did not receive its private gold")
	}
	for _, field := range []string{"gold", "exp", "items"} {
		if _, ok := other[field]; ok {
			t.Fatalf("spatial view leaked private %s", field)
		}
	}
	if _, ok := other["scene_id"]; !ok {
		t.Fatal("spatial view lost public position")
	}

	clients[0].mu.Lock()
	oldRaw := append([]byte(nil), clients[0].lastRaw...)
	oldEpoch := clients[0].epoch
	clients[0].mu.Unlock()
	// 先完成权威切图，模拟订阅准入失败；客户端保持旧视图，旧图观察者已移除该人。
	if _, err := syncsender.NewEnterSceneSender(engine).MultiSync_EnterScene(ctx, players[0].ID(), scenes[1].ID(), 500, 500); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	refused := errors.New("instance warming up")
	if err := world.Reconcile(ctx, players[0].ID(), func() error { return refused }); !errors.Is(err, refused) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	flush()
	clients[1].expect(t, players[1].ID())
	if err := world.Reconcile(ctx, players[0].ID(), nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	flush()
	clients[0].expect(t, players[0].ID(), players[2].ID())
	clients[2].expect(t, players[0].ID(), players[2].ID())
	clients[0].mu.Lock()
	applied, replayErr := clients[0].receiver.Receive(oldRaw, func(frame.Frame) error { return errors.New("old scene was applied") })
	newEpoch := clients[0].epoch
	clients[0].mu.Unlock()
	if applied || replayErr != nil || newEpoch <= oldEpoch {
		t.Fatalf("old epoch applied=%v err=%v epochs=%d/%d", applied, replayErr, oldEpoch, newEpoch)
	}
	// 同一份持久归属恢复新连接；旧 TCP 连接的帧留在其旧 Receiver 内，不能混入新客户端。
	_ = clients[0].connection.Close()
	waitActiveSessions(t, transport, 9701, 0)
	if err := world.Disconnect(players[0].ID()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	flush()
	clients[2].expect(t, players[2].ID())
	reconnected := dialMMOWireClient(t, addr, 9701)
	waitActiveSessions(t, transport, 9701, 1)
	if err := world.Reconcile(ctx, players[0].ID(), nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	flush()
	reconnected.expect(t, players[0].ID(), players[2].ID())
	clients[2].expect(t, players[0].ID(), players[2].ID())
}
